svg.title: Camera views before and after stacking
svg.desc: Before: 3 separate 224 x 224 images (top, left wrist, right wrist), one file each. After: one 224 x 672 image with the 3 views stacked, which the reader cuts back into 3.
svg.text: What the camera views look like, before and after
One real frame (number 1,500), decoded from the public test videos.
224 x 672 pixels. The reader cuts it at the dashed lines.
The black bands are in the source dataset (lerobot/abc_130k_v3_train). Frames shown at 180 px; the videos are 224 px wide.
